scope: All stored Dstar candidates, including original unmatched candidates, in every event of all 5114 upstream ROOTs across PR3 and NPR3.
matching: Independent nearest final-state charged hadron per original RECO track, same charge, deltaR<0.03, abs(recoPt-genPt)/recoPt<0.5, common exact D0/Dstar ancestry.
origin: matchGEN is PYTHIA only; matchHYDJET is HYDJET only.
thread: One CPU and one thread per worker; ROOT implicit MT disabled.
identity: Same exact original-track pT-error/charge/hits lookup; original dz+xy disambiguation, unique exact xy fallback already used for the three central repairs.
optimization: Eta-phi grid only prunes GEN candidates outside the deltaR neighborhood; retained candidates are compared in original pool order.
replacement: Write sibling temporary ROOT, compare all original events/candidates and all nonmatching branch values plus matching results, atomically replace original path only on PASS. Do not retain the pre-replacement ROOT.
unchanged: All nonmatching physics branches, GEN arrays, other trees and histograms; original event/candidate order.
normalization: Existing weights and membership are not recalculated or altered.
central_comparison: Compare all common 2921397 central candidate identities with the completed matching friend before replacement.
protected_original: KNU root://cluster142.knu.ac.kr/store/user/junseok/DStarMC is read-only and never replaced. Only the distinct GP /home/CMS analysis copies are replaced.
